semantics.authorship: Project-authored requirement decomposition and mapping decisions. ONVIF publishes the cited normative sources; this ledger is not an ONVIF publication or a conformance certificate.
semantics.sourceRequirementLevel: The literal M, C, O and starred M*/C*/C** table cell is retained independently of the effective requirementLevel and its enclosing feature conditions. A star can denote a condition or an alternative; only explicit obligation groups are alternatives.
semantics.conditions: Evaluate the fact/equals, all, any and not AST with true, false and unknown. Missing, unauthorized, unreachable, uninspected and invalid observations are unknown, not false. Compare JSON values without string/number/boolean coercion.
semantics.featureSupport: A conditional feature is triggered by supported functionality in any way, including proprietary implementations. Negative native evidence alone cannot negate proprietary support. Facts are bound to their declared role and endpoint/service/resource scope.
semantics.optional: Optional means permitted, not unsupported. An optional function within a conditional feature retains that outer condition.
semantics.groups: An atom with obligationGroupId is an alternative member, not an independently universal requirement. Evaluate its atLeastN group and all requirements in each selected branch. Multiple successful branches are allowed. Independent dependency atoms remain independently enforceable.
semantics.clientProjection: Client atoms are consumption, decoding, lifecycle or process obligations in a client requirement manifest. They do not create client-hosted copies of device actions or event forms.
semantics.deviceProjection: Native SOAP operations are actions by default, including reads and authorized writes. No implicit writable property aliases are introduced. Describing an operation never authorizes discovery, inspection or these vectors to execute it.
semantics.nativeIdentity: Resolve every operation by serviceNamespace + portType + operation, not local name. Imported WS-Notification Renew uses its real SubscriptionManager portType; its endpoint is still the ONVIF Event subscription EPR.
semantics.topics: A topic string starts with an expanded ONVIF topic namespace followed by the local path. Every path step belongs to that topic namespace. No lexical tns1 prefix is required. Topic presence does not assert a complete Source/Key/Data payload schema.
semantics.evidenceTargets: Vector pointers are offline mapping evidence targets, not evidence that a product implements a requirement. Runtime and process evidence must be supplied separately, with issuer, firmware/build identity, scope, time and provenance.
semantics.defaults: Only a validated applicable native response can supply an XSD default, with its source recorded. No response means no default. A native default does not negate unknown proprietary functionality or prove installed resource counts.
semantics.conditionEvidenceSelectors: A condition fact valuePath is an explanatory native contract locator, not executable XPath or an XML codec selector. Resolve real element/attribute QNames from the locked contract. A null fact default means missing fact evidence is unknown even when an applicable native response could supply an XSD default.
semantics.conformance: Profile edition, advertised claim, observed capability, runtime support and firmware-specific registered conformance are separate evidence classes. A model link, operation success or profile discovery scope cannot establish conformance.

mappingPolicies.reason: A, C and D cover networked appliances or software, PACS units, aggregates and peripherals. Neither Camera nor NetworkVideoTransmitter is a prerequisite for these profiles.

AuthenticationBehavior is a separately locked optional service. A reference to an authentication profile or recognition type does not add universal A/C/D AuthenticationBehavior operations, multi-factor authentication or biometric transfer requirements.

Canonical identity includes stable EPR identity, service namespace, resource kind, native token and applicable parent identity. Preserve EPR reference parameters, opaque token spelling and directional/cross-service links. Do not merge by token, hostname, display name or IP address. Native service-unique token violations remain diagnostics even when canonical kind-qualified keys differ.

Discovery descriptions and public model metadata must not contain credential identifiers, PIN/password values, holder information, biometric material or access histories. Preserve native schemas and protected invocation semantics rather than publishing example values as live state. Redaction is a project publication policy, not a fabricated profile table requirement.

CredentialIdentifier.Value and CredentialIdentifierItem.Value are xs:hexBinary data with leading zero octets preserved. CredentialToken is an opaque PACS ReferenceToken, not that data and not an HTTP password. CredentialIdentifier also requires ExemptedFromAuthentication; the whitelist/blacklist item does not. Recognition classes do not require real biometric samples.

The device emits a request event; the client invokes the device AccessControl PACSPort ExternalAuthorization operation. Its request contains AccessPointToken, optional CredentialToken, optional Reason and Decision. There is no RequestID field. D identifier requests can receive an anonymous decision when the holder is not identified.
